endToEndOrientation: End to end, a mirror or a quarter turn can change whether the base cuts the body on the wall’s inner face at all: the band claim upstream (plan-decomposition.ts:509, unchanged and identical in the 005Q base) breaks a tie between the wall’s two faces toward the lower pixel, so in some orientations the body is cut on the outer face and there is no strip (wall-strip.test.ts family 13: family 1 mirrored top–bottom or turned 90°; family 16: the L and the platform fixture likewise). The rule names the strip exactly where the base reads one, on the side the wall is drawn on (family 13 and 16 redraws; wall-strip-invariance.test.ts, both outcomes exercised). That dependence is a property of the base, not of the rule; G10 is evaluated on the rule, at unit level.
